answer: Sybil Sentry: 1) Each identity stakes 10 tokens. 2) A reporter proves Sybil status, slashing the identity's stake. 3) The reporter earns 2 tokens from the slashed stake. Cost for N identities: $10 N. Example: 100 identities cost $1000. Failure: Actor acquires 50% of staked tokens. This system is like a meadow where every plant must pay a fee; a reporter, like a falcon, identifies weeds, which are uprooted, with the reporter gaining from the penalty, all protected by the cedar of the protocol.
